arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean start, and it's great that your contact email is easy to find. One suggestion: the site is quite minimal right now, so adding a short intro about yourself, a few sections (like interests or projects), and maybe a photo would make it feel more personal and engaging. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that you share your passion for hiking — it gives the blog a clear focus and personality. A couple of ideas to make it even better: add some posts with photos from your hikes, share trail recommendations or tips, and maybe include a short "About me" section so readers can connect with you. Looking forward to reading more!
